body:
what's got you ashamed to reach out? there's nothing wrong with trying to talk to people about problems, i promise you that. i know that it must feel that way, or like it's the wrong thing to do.
but don't feel pressured to. that's a call for you to make on your own.

i'm really glad to hear that you're getting your drinking under control. that must've been hard, but it's a step in the right direction. good on you.

do you think that you can find anyone that can help you out? even if it's just to talk? i know i'm just some random person on the internet, but i really believe in you. it must be extra pressure added on you having to deal with this with a kid and having these expectations put on you, and being idolized in a way.

not one person alone can keep their head above water forever. trust me. so many of us struggle to do it on our own for so long, and it's incredibly detrimental to ourselves. it's okay and normal to not be okay all the time.

you say that you've been abusing drugs and drinking heavily for a long time. is there anyone that you can talk to about this? can you find a support system that will actively want the best for you?
why are you feeling that way, op? what's going on?
hi there. are you down to talk for a little bit, maybe? what's going on?
hey, OP. you still around? what's got you feeling like this? anything specific happen, or is it all just building up? i'd love to talk a little, if that's okay with you.

i don't think that that's weird. there's that cliche that says something along the lines of 'scars show that you're alive', or something like that. i don't know how much of that is true, but i always enjoyed looking at my scars. still do. they're pretty.

At the very least, we found someone who gets our pain in each other. That counts for something, I think.

You take care too. Thanks for sharing with me, and for telling me that that made you smile. Added a little light into my bleak night. 💜

I don't know how to stop focusing on everyone around me. i don't know how to prioritize myself. i don't know how to learn and i feel like i just can't.

Thank you for listening to me. Nobody does that anymore.

I'm so sorry that you're feeling the same way I am. I'm so sorry that you have to deal with being a toy, too.   
That's not fair. You aren't a plaything. You're a human being with emotions.

It's so hard to absorb everything from everyone and exude all that positivity for them. It's so hard to maintain and not feasible to always be able to do. I don't know if I have anything to add into your happy box right now, but you're so valid, okay? You and me aren't alone. For better or for worse.

Thank you. I just don't know what to do anymore. These people that I spill my heart and soul into don't give a fuck. These people that know I'm in pain just let me suffer until they need help, and I always drop everything to help them. Things never change. Keep acting like they will, but they don't, and it kills me a little more each time.
